name: Galaxy S4

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 4.2.2 "Jelly Bean" with TouchWiz Nature UX 2.0, Current: Android 5.0.1 "Lollipop" with TouchWiz Nature UX 4.0, Unofficial: up to Android 14 "Upside Down Cake" via LineageOS 21 (I9506)
Platform.Chipset: Exynos 5 Octa 5410 (3G & South Korea LTE Versions), Qualcomm Snapdragon 600 (LTE & China Mobile TD-SCDMA versions)
Platform.CPU: 1.6 GHz quad-core Cortex-A15 and 1.2 GHz quad-core Cortex-A7 (big.LITTLE) (3G & South Korea LTE Versions), 1.9 GHz quad-core Krait 300 (LTE & China Mobile TD-SCDMA versions)
Platform.GPU: IT tri-core PowerVR SGX 544 GPU (3G & South Korea LTE Versions), Adreno 320 (LTE & China Mobile TD-SCDMA versions)

Display.Display: 5 in 1920x1080 px (441 ppi) Super AMOLED, (Diamond PenTile), Corning Gorilla Glass 3

Cameras.Front camera: 2 megapixels (1080p) HD Video Recording @ 30 frames/s Back-illuminated sensor

Sound.Sound: Mono speaker on back side with Qualcomm DAC or Wolfson Microelectronics WM5102 audio chip depending on version

Battery.Battery: 2600 mAh Li-ion, User replaceable, Qi wireless charging (optionally retrofittable)
Battery.Charging: USB Battery Charging 1.2 (USB-BC) up to 10 W (5 V/2 A), Qi wireless charging requires special back cover
